scope: Two additional high-reach/OPM public medley candidates from the current research pass; no production assignment is modified.

entries.title: Sa Aking Puso
entries.note: Known-good control passed 3 independent sustained-playback runs.

entries.title: Karaoke - Donna Cruz Medley
entries.evidence: Public video result reports 3,880,997 views and lists Rain, Only Me and You, and Kapag Tumibok ang Puso. Runtime qualification is pending this batch; audio/presentation is unreviewed.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.004 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 6 in the final five seconds.

entries.title: Men Oppose Medley
entries.evidence: Public result reports 2,206,429 views and lists Kasalanan Ba, Pag-Ibig Ko Sayo'y Di Magbabago, Sabi Mo Ako Lamang, and Sabihin Mong Lagi. Runtime and actual karaoke presentation remain to be tested.
entries.note: Sustained playback verified: 17 readable samples over 15.008 seconds, 15.0 seconds of advancement, and 15 advancing intervals including 5 in the final five seconds.
